title: List the new service-ai-studio tool ask_which in PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE and give it a chatbot.tool label in every locale
body:
repo:cloud#3 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZqfEd7pcckjz3pGqn

Filing gate: asked by the card thread of objectstack-ai/cloud#4773 (p1), settled by the seat (land the cloud side now, with a named debt that removes itself on the next pin bump). Same shape as #34270 and #34368.

## What happens

The cloud package `service-ai-studio` adds an ask-only tool, `ask_which`: when a data question has 2–3 plausible readings, the in-app ask agent returns them to the user as a question and ends the turn instead of guessing one reading. The framework does not know the name yet:

- `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']` (the spec's platform tool-name registry, pinned by `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.test.ts`) does not list it.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` has no `chatbot.tool.ask_which`, so `humanizeToolName` in `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot` falls back to the English "Ask which" as the chat step's title, even in a Chinese chat.

## Expected

1. `ask_which` is in `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']`.
2. Every locale pack has `chatbot.tool.ask_which`, worded like its neighbours (for example zh-Hans 「确认问题含义」, en "Clarify the question").
3. The registry's own test and the locale-completeness check stay green. The cloud side's AHEAD_OF_REGISTRY entry for this name (`platform-tool-names-conformance`) is deleted on the pin bump that carries this.

Not blocking: the cloud side lands with the named AHEAD entry.
